# Policies

## What is your cancellation policy?

We require at least 72 hours notice to cancel or change your move date in order to receive your deposit back.

## How is my move billed / when does the clock start?

You are billed from the moment the movers arrive at your pick-up location until the move-in process is fully complete at your final destination.

## What is the minimum charge and how is time billed after that?

There is a 3-hour minimum labor charge. After that, billing is in 15-minute increments at the same hourly rate.

## Are there extra charges for heavy items?

Yes. Items weighing 150 lbs or more that need to be carried up/down stairs, or any item over 250 lbs regardless of stairs, may incur additional charges (e.g. double-door fridges, pianos, safes, treadmills). These must be coordinated with the office in advance.

HANDLING: Escalate exact amount to office

## What is Double Drive Time (DDT)?

If the distance between pick-up and delivery address is more than 15 miles, transportation is charged as Double Drive Time, added on top of the 3-hour minimum.

## Who pays for parking tickets during the move?

If we receive a parking ticket while loading or unloading, the customer is responsible for reimbursing the full amount of the ticket.

## What if everything doesn't fit in one truck?

We can't always guarantee everything fits in one trip. If needed, we can provide an additional truck subject to availability, at an additional charge. Arrival time and truck size depend on the company's schedule.

## Do you move plants?

We do not assume responsibility for the safe transportation of plants, since our trucks can shake during transit and there's no secure way to protect them.

## What happens if I don't pay in full after the move?

Per California Public Utilities Commission rules governing moving companies, customers must pay the full amount after movers complete the job. If not paid in full, the company reserves the right not to honor any customer claims.

HANDLING: Sensitive/legal - keep wording exact

## Is my stuff insured during the move?

Yes, all items are automatically covered under released-value protection at $0.60 per pound per article, at no additional cost.

HANDLING: This is basic valuation, not full insurance - be precise

## Will movers hook up appliances or hang TVs/art?

We are not authorized to do plumbing work (hooking up fridges, washers/dryers — though unhooking at pick-up is fine), drill holes, or hang artwork/TVs.
